Reason for Mistake: **The Planner incorrectly concluded that Marshall Neilan (director of "His Last Haul") died later than Joseph H. Lewis (director of "The Falcon in San Francisco"). This error occurred due to a reversal of death dates during the comparison. The death dates retrieved showed Marshall Neilan died on October 27, 1958, while Joseph H. Lewis died on August 30, 2000. The Planner failed to correctly sequence the dates and misinterpreted which director died later, leading to an erroneous final answer. This matches the error pattern of "Misinterpreted Date Comparison" seen in Example 1.**
